name: beecargo
description: Publish files from OpenCode and get durable Beecargo share links via hosted MCP. Connect with Beecargo OAuth — no API key to paste.

installation.summary: Add the hosted MCP URL, then complete Connect with Beecargo OAuth in the browser.
installation.markdown:
## Installation

```bash
opencode mcp add beecargo --url https://mcp.beecargo.net/mcp
opencode mcp auth beecargo
```

Approve access in the browser when prompted. Confirm with:

```bash
opencode mcp list
```

Docs: [beecargo.net/docs/mcp/overview](https://beecargo.net/docs/mcp/overview)

usage.markdown:
## Usage

1. After OAuth, call `beecargo_register_agent` for a lasting `bc_*` key (session keeps it).
2. Upload with `beecargo_upload` and a public HTTPS `url` (preferred).
3. Return the share link `https://beecargo.net/d/{shortId}` to humans.

Guest bootstrap without account OAuth: `https://mcp.beecargo.net/mcp/guest`.
